subject: Upcoming Team Building Event at Our Company
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual team building event will be held on Friday, May 21st at the local park. This year's event will include team building activities, games, and a BBQ lunch. Please mark your calendars and RSVP by May 14th so we can ensure we have enough food and supplies for everyone. We look forward to a fun day of bonding and camaraderie. Best regards, The Organizing Committee
